# Nave cabinet impulse responses

Yves Vogl of Basilica Audio dedicated these nine modelled guitar and bass cabinet
impulse responses to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal. See
[CC0-1.0.txt](CC0-1.0.txt).

The WAVs are unchanged from [Nave revision f1d1279](https://github.com/basilica-audio/Nave/tree/f1d1279d64983e1788b39126bd58ce29b6a67846/resources/irs).
Their SHA-256 hashes match the [upstream manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basilica-audio/Nave/f1d1279d64983e1788b39126bd58ce29b6a67846/resources/irs/manifest.json).
